items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser suits oily and sensitive-leaning skin without stripping it before a retinol.
The 0.3% retinol is a sensible starting strength for softening the look of fine lines on sensitive, fair skin.
A ceramide moisturizer supports the skin's comfort and helps cushion retinol dryness without feeling heavy.
A mineral SPF 50 is gentle on sensitive skin and is needed every morning while using retinol.

response.routine_note: Use the retinol at night after cleansing, starting 2 nights a week and slowly adding nights as your skin feels comfortable, then follow with moisturizer, and do a small patch test first. Apply the mineral SPF every morning, and avoid using exfoliating acids or scrubs on the same nights.
